verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own docs say full-disk encryption is mandatory, and the installer is described as just answering five questions before it "hands back a finished desktop." A switcher therefore gets encryption by default rather than configuring it by hand. The evidence is a single brief vendor statement, with no detail on how encryption is set up or whether it also applies to dual-boot or unattended installs. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the encryption setup flow, confirmation of encryption behavior for dual-boot and unattended installs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I get full-disk encryption enabled automatically without manual security setup

citations.quote: Write the ISO to a USB stick and answer five questions. It hands back a finished desktop.
